data.name: Darkarta: A Broken Heart's Quest Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Darkarta: A Broken Heart’s Quest (Collector’s Edition)

How far would you go to save your only daughter from the clutches of death?

From the award-winning studio Tuttifrutti Interactive comes an untold saga of motherhood and true love. Darkarta: A Broken Heart’s Quest is a frantic, emotional journey set against the backdrop of the enchanted valleys and forgotten legends of the Indus civilization.

The Story

For Mary, her daughter Sophia is her entire world. Seeking to rediscover her long-lost family roots, Mary travels with her husband and daughter to a cluster of remote islands. Her life is shattered in an instant when a mysterious letter arrives, unearthing a dark past she never knew existed.

Now, broken and betrayed, Mary must enter the Netherworld—a realm where destiny is written in blood and danger lurks in every corner. Step into Mary’s shoes and navigate a perilous game of life and death to bring your daughter home.

Why Play Darkarta?

  • A Legacy of Excellence: A former #1 Classic Hit on PC and Mac markets (Big Fish Games) and winner of over 10 International Awards, including honors from Game Connection America and Casual Connect Asia.

  • An Epic Journey: Explore a magnificent fictional world inspired by Indus fantasy, ancient mythologies, and the philosophy of reincarnation.

  • A Powerful Message: Beyond the mystery, this is a story about "star-crossed lovers" and a stand against racism, upholding the enduring power of humanity and motherhood.

  • Stunning Artistry: Immerse yourself in critically acclaimed, breathtaking visuals and highly detailed environments.

Standard Edition Features

  • 5-6 Hours of Gameplay: Experience a gripping main story with non-repetitive puzzles and unforeseen environments.

  • Prequel Comic Book: Dive deeper into the lore with a beautifully illustrated backstory.

  • Mom’s Diary: Follow Mary’s journey through her personal notes, character sketches, and an integrated strategy map.

Collector’s Edition Exclusives

  • Bonus Chapter: "Rising of the Phoenix": Extend your adventure and play in "GOD Mode" for a unique gameplay perspective.

  • Nostalgic Collectibles: Find 30 precious memory items scattered throughout your quest.

  • Hall of Fame: Earn 36 distinct medals and prove your mastery.

  • Morphing Objects: Hunt for 28 hidden morphing objects during or after your playthrough.

  • The Vault: Enjoy mesmerizing soundtracks, concept art, and high-quality wallpapers.

  • Ultimate Replayability: Re-experience your favorite Mini-Games, Hidden Object Scenes, and cinematic Cut-scenes at any time.

3,700 years have passed, but time cannot heal a broken heart. Will you answer the call?

data.short_description: Haunted by mysterious curses from her orphanage days, Mary is finally forced to confront the truth behind her past. Step into the enchanted Netherworld—a realm where destiny is written in blood and every choice shapes her fate. An award-winning adventure blending mystery, emotion, and dark fantasy.
